delta_summary: Enforces physical raw-tick timestamp measurement without lookahead assignment, structural expected output separation, and strict non-leaking closed-bar causal replay.

changed_files.purpose: Decouples actual replay from expected comparisons, counts raw ticks per bar, records max_raw_tick_ts_used and max_bar_ts_used physically, and evaluates strategies causally on closed bars ending <= decision timestamp.
Invokes run_raw_tick_replay independently and compares via compare_replay_to_expected; checks strict physical condition (max_raw_tick_ts_used <= decision_ts and max_bar_ts_used <= decision_ts).
Records 370 trace executions containing primitive physical measurement fields (raw_tick_count_used, bar_count_used, max_bar_ts_used, max_raw_tick_ts_used <= decision_epoch).
Formal registry distinguishing production component reachability from historical replay scope.
